saw_lines: Outdoor buyers pick a cool bag or picnic bag for one trip and ask how it arrives before how it looks.
So the sale is lost in the ad when a buyer cannot tell whether a cool bag arrives whole.
Your 0 of 2 ads answer how it arrives, though your site does, so show the box arriving in one new video ad.
ads_1: Video of the box arriving at the door, answering delivery in the first line
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Instagram and YouTube
